ceo.name: Brian Niccol
ceo.background: MBA from University of Chicago Booth. 10 years at P&G in brand management. VP Strategy/CMO/GM at Pizza Hut. CEO of Taco Bell (2015-2018): doubled system sales, opened 2000 new restaurants, only 1 quarter of negative SSS. CEO of Chipotle (2018-2024): revenue nearly doubled, profits increased ~7x, stock +770%. Named Starbucks Chairman & CEO August 2024, started September 2024.
ceo.track_record: At Chipotle: restored brand after food-safety crisis, restaurant-level margins from 19% to 28.9%, AUV from ~$2M to $3M+, stock +770% vs S&P +99%. At Taco Bell: doubled system sales, expanded internationally. At Starbucks: launched 'Back to Starbucks' plan, Q1 FY2026 revenue $9.9B (+6%), rewards members record 35.5M, but 6 consecutive quarters of negative SSS globally through fiscal Q3 2025.
ceo.compensation: Starting salary $1.6M, $10M signing bonus, $75M in equity grants vesting over time. Day-one announcement drove SBUX stock +24% (best day since 1992 IPO).

cfo.name: Cathy R. Smith
cfo.background: University of Southern California. ~40-year career in corporate finance. CFO roles: Raytheon (1986-2003), Textron (2003-2005), Kennametal (2005-2006), Centex (2006-2009), GameStop (2009-2010), Walmart International (2010-2014), Express Scripts (2014-2015), Target (2015-2020), Bright Health Group (2020-2023), Nordstrom (2023-2025). At Target: roughly doubled enterprise value during her tenure. Led Centex-Pulte merger (2009). Helped take Nordstrom private. Appointed SBUX CFO March 4, 2025, succeeding Rachel Ruggeri. $5M cash signing bonus (forfeited ~$15M from Nordstrom).

recent_changes.description: Brian Niccol named Chairman & CEO, replacing Laxman Narasimhan (CEO) and Mellody Hobson (Chairman). SBUX stock +24% on announcement.
North America leadership shake-up: Mike Grams appointed EVP North America Chief Stores Officer. Sara Trilling departed after 20+ years (role split in two). Supply chain chief Arthur also departed.
Cathy Smith appointed CFO, succeeding Rachel Ruggeri. $5M signing bonus.
Board elected Dambisa Moyo and Marissa Mayer as new directors, bringing board to 11 members.
Organizational restructuring: Global Coffee & Sustainability and Global Brand teams merged under Chief Brand Officer. CLO Brad Lerman set to leave.
Anand Varadarajan joined as EVP & CTO (from Amazon). Mike Grams expanded to COO role.

insider_ownership_detail.recent_trend: Insiders net buyers in past 3 months (as of early 2026)

compensation_highlights: 2025 proxy: 86% shareholder Say-on-Pay approval. FY2025 returned $2.8B to shareholders via dividends (15th consecutive annual increase, ~17.5% CAGR). Niccol: $1.6M salary + $10M signing bonus + $75M equity grants. Cathy Smith: $5M signing bonus. Rachel Ruggeri (former CFO): $494K salary + $4.37M stock + $1.92M other = ~$6.78M total.
governance_notes: 11-member board as of June 2025. Brian Niccol serves as Chairman & CEO (combined role). Jorgen Vig Knudstorp is Lead Independent Director (since March 2025, board member since 2017). Board additions in 2025: Dambisa Moyo (global economist, ex-Goldman Sachs, boards of Chevron/Conde Nast) and Marissa Mayer (CEO Sunshine AI, ex-Yahoo/Google CEO, boards of Walmart/AT&T/Hilton). Other directors: Ritch Allison, Andrew Campion, Beth Ford, Neal Mohan, Daniel Servitje, Mike Sievert, Wei Zhang.
